hypotheses.claim: A stable effect_operation_id bound to semantic request fingerprint is necessary for safe cross-retry effect identity and auditability.
hypotheses.support: Harness idempotency race + local crash-window probe + independent API/messaging analogues.
hypotheses.falsifier: A production ClayCode effect gateway achieves deterministic retry/recovery across duplicate/concurrent/crash cases without a stable operation identity or equivalent mechanism.

hypotheses.claim: ClayCode effect ABI should represent delivery/recovery guarantees explicitly rather than treating REQUESTED..DONE lifecycle as a generic exactly-once guarantee.
hypotheses.falsifier: A smaller existing contract preserves all crash/retry semantics in production without ambiguity or false DONE states.

hypotheses.claim: The missing mechanism can be implemented in runtime/type-effect ABI without changing core ClayCode surface syntax or universal computational semantics.
hypotheses.falsifier: A compiled real application or FRANK component cannot express required recovery guarantees through existing constraint/type/effect mechanisms plus runtime ABI metadata.
